name: Events Route - Past Results From The October All-Hands
description: The /events past grid now that the NYC Fall Welcome Mixer is written up after the fact: its card leads with "Sold out within 24 hours, with more than 90% of registrants attending", the October 2026 volunteer all-hands figure, instead of the old space-is-limited pitch. The card clamps its description, which is why the result comes first. The grid now opens with the London Alumni Founders Co-working Day of October 9, one of the two London events the Luma import missed while Luma was refusing its requests (fixed 2026-11-06 by naming the importer in a User-Agent header); the earlier monthly London co-working days fill the rest of the frame, and Alumni Day (June 5) is below the fold. The hover only scrolls the past grid into view.
